## From a buyer's brief to a matched, verified shipment.
Machine learning-powered precision matching across Australia’s vineyards, with one simple process from brief to delivery.
You share your brief.
Style, region, price band and volume, no wine jargon needed. Your brief becomes the start of a pallet made only for you.
Our AI matches it.

You confirm your order.
Pick from your tailored shortlist and we lock in stock and pricing with each vineyard. One order, one invoice.
Vineyards prepare your wine.
Independent vineyards across Australia pack your cases in parallel, reaching markets they couldn’t reach alone .
Pallet is consolidated.
Your cases join other buyers’ orders on one mixed, one-of-a-kind pallet : a cellar’s worth of variety, packed and booked to port.
Export, simplified.

## Why Sapphire Panda exists.
No vineyard should be locked out of exporting because of its size, yet the complexity of the Australian wine export market has left it dominated by a few commercial brands. Thousands of award-winning vineyards can't compete on scale or price, so their wines go untasted and their stories untold. Sapphire Panda exists to change that.
Growing up less than an hour from the Yarra Valley and visiting independent vineyards rich in history and award-winning wine, Conor took it as common knowledge that Australia’s best wine often comes from its smallest producers. Working overseas, he found a market dominated by a few commercial brands, with small and medium-sized Australian vineyards barely represented.
After attending the Belt and Road Summit in Hong Kong and events with Business Network International, he spoke with buyers at clubs, venues and restaurants across Europe and Asia, who wanted boutique, distinctive Australian wine but had no reliable way to find it.
Back home, minimum orders, paperwork and the big players' marketing budgets stood between vineyards and export. So we built the alternative: AI that matches each buyer's requirements to the best-fit vineyard in Australia, whatever its size, and combines them on one pallet. One order, greater variety, and less complexity. A win for both sides.
Conor has spent his career in management consulting and consumer goods, working on go-to-market strategy and AI transformation across Australia, the UK, the Czech Republic, and Poland.
Most recently at Deloitte, he worked on the rollout of large-scale AI across supply chains and operations for public and private sector clients. He holds a Bachelor and Master of Business from Monash University.
Sapphire Panda brings that experience to wine. AI-led matching puts the best wine in front of buyers on merit, not marketing budget.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.text:
## Frequently asked questions
Short answers for buyers and for vineyards. If yours isn’t here, get in touch.
## For buyers
How does the engine work?
Tell us your region, flavour profile, price point and volume. Our engine searches Australian vineyards and recommends the best fits, including ones most buyers have never heard of.
Why haven’t I seen these wines before?
Just five companies make up more than 75% of Australia’s wine export sales. For smaller wineries, minimum order quantities, export licensing and marketing budgets have made exporting too costly, so their wines rarely reach overseas buyers. We pool several wineries onto one shipment and handle the export paperwork, so you can access wines that weren’t available to you before.
Who are the vineyards?
Our focus is independent Australian vineyards, especially smaller ones that are hard for overseas buyers to find. Many have never exported, because minimum orders, export licensing and marketing costs have kept them out. Any Australian vineyard is welcome to register, whatever its size and whether or not it has exported before.
Can I mix wines from different vineyards in one order?
Yes. We combine them on one pallet, with one order, one contact and one invoice.
What’s the minimum order?
48 bottles (4 cases) per order, and at least 1 case (12 bottles) from each vineyard you order from. You can mix wines from the same vineyard however you like.
How much does it cost?
Each wine shows one price per bottle for your destination, with shipping and paperwork included. The price you see is the price you pay.
Can I taste before I commit?
Yes. Request a sample pack of up to 12 wines, sent as sample vials rather than full bottles. What you pay for the wine in your samples is deducted from your first order of 48 bottles or more, placed within 90 days. Shipping and handling aren’t deducted.
Who handles shipping and paperwork?
We do. We handle consolidation, export documents and shipping, including registering wines for export where needed, and you receive one invoice. We’ll confirm delivery timing when you place your order.
## For vineyards
How do I join?
Register your interest on the vineyard page . We’ll contact you to collect the full details.
Does it cost anything to be listed?
No. Listing is free, with no joining fees. We don’t take ownership of your stock.
What are the requirements to be listed?
To be listed, we ask that you:
are a recognised, registered Australian vineyard or wine producer
have a range of wines available to sell
stay committed to fulfilling the orders for the wines you list
maintain the quality buyers expect
We recommend your wines to buyers on the strength of what you list, and we act on buyer feedback. Vineyards that list wines they can’t supply, or that receive repeated poor quality feedback, may be removed from the platform.
Registering your interest doesn’t guarantee listing. We’ll contact you to collect the full details and confirm that you meet the requirements.
Do I need to be exporting already?
No. Whether you’ve exported before or this would be your first time, we handle the export documents and registrations.
Which states do you work with?
We work with vineyards in every Australian state and territory. Register your interest and we’ll be in touch.
How is my wine recommended to a buyer?
The engine recommends wines based on what the buyer asked for: region, style, price and volume. A vineyard’s size or marketing budget isn’t a factor. That’s why we reach out before onboarding to collect the details we need, so the engine has everything it needs to recommend your wines to the right buyers.
## Still have a question?
We’d love to hear from you.

pages.title: Find your match (buyer brief tool)
pages.text:
## Tell us what you're after.
No wine jargon required — just what matters to you. Our matching engine will score it against independent Australian vineyards, including wineries exporting for the first time, to find your fit.
## Who's asking
So we know who to prepare the match for.
Business name (required)
Business location (required)
## Budget & volume
Helps us prioritise what's realistic for your order.
Price band (minimum required) (landed, per bottle)
Total order size (bottles, optional)
Your total order volume across all wines, not per wine. You’ll choose how many bottles of each wine at the next step.
Exclusivity (optional)
## What you're looking for
Tap everything that would work — there's no wrong answer.
Wine style (required — pick at least one)
Varietal (optional)
Search styles and grapes
Body (optional)
Flavour notes (optional)
## Where it's from
Narrow it down by state and region, or skip to see everything.
State (optional)
Each state shows how many wine regions it covers — tap one to see them.
Region preference (optional)
Search regions (optional)
